gateHook:
#!/bin/sh
# Mandatory local check and gate before every push (rightkit-gate install-hook). Never bypass with --no-verify.
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 1
stdin=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rightkit-gate.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$stdin"' EXIT
cat > "$stdin"
# core.hooksPath hides .git/hooks: run the repository's own pre-push hook first.
own="$(git rev-parse --git-dir)/hooks/pre-push"
if [ -x "$own" ]; then
  echo "rightkit-gate: running $own" >&2
  "$own" "$@" < "$stdin" || exit $?
fi
# The gate binary: the root install, any workspace package's install, then pnpm exec.
found=""
for bin in node_modules/.bin/rightkit-gate */node_modules/.bin/rightkit-gate */*/node_modules/.bin/rightkit-gate */*/*/node_modules/.bin/rightkit-gate; do
  if [ -x "$bin" ]; then found="$bin"; break; fi
done
if command -v rightkit-host-gate >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "rightkit-gate: using host trusted gate" >&2
  rightkit_gate() { rightkit-host-gate "$@"; }
elif [ -f "$HOME/Library/Application Support/RightKit/build-control/config.json" ] || [ -f /d/.rightkit-managed/config.json ]; then
  echo "rightkit-gate: managed host is missing rightkit-host-gate" >&2
  exit 1
elif [ -n "$found" ]; then
  echo "rightkit-gate: using $found" >&2
  rightkit_gate() { "$found" "$@"; }
elif command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "rightkit-gate: using pnpm exec rightkit-gate" >&2
  rightkit_gate() { pnpm exec rightkit-gate "$@"; }
else
  echo "rightkit-gate: using node node_modules/@rightkit/release/bin/rightkit-gate.mjs" >&2
  rightkit_gate() { node "node_modules/@rightkit/release/bin/rightkit-gate.mjs" "$@"; }
fi
# The check first, over the committed files of HEAD; a push that only deletes refs has nothing to check.
if [ -s "$stdin" ] && ! awk '$2 !~ /^0+$/ { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' "$stdin"; then
  echo "rightkit-gate: only deletions are pushed; nothing to check" >&2
else
  rightkit_gate check --commit HEAD < /dev/null >&2 || exit $?
fi
rightkit_gate --base origin/main < "$stdin"; exit $?

ownershipHook:
#!/bin/sh
# rightkit-ownership-precommit v1: advisory ownership gate installed by `right-release hooks install`.
# Block-tier findings without a valid exception fail here; --no-verify bypasses this gate.
# Authoritative enforcement remains in broker admission and the release gate.
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 1
HOOKS_DIR="$(dirname "$0")"
if [ -x "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit.rightkit-foreign" ]; then
  "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit.rightkit-foreign" "$@" || exit $?
fi
GATE="$ROOT/node_modules/@rightkit/release/cli/right-release.mjs"
if [ ! -f "$GATE" ]; then
  echo "[rightkit] @rightkit/release is not installed in this repository; add it as a devDependency, then re-run: right-release hooks install" >&2
  exit 1
fi
exec node "$GATE" ownership --staged
